name: Layla
source:
Layla is a friendly girl in [url=https://vndb.org/c131857]Melanie[/url]'s class. She often sits near Melanie because she wants to get to know her, but only occasionally does she start conversations. She sees that Melanie is a lone wolf and doesn't try to press her too much, she wants to let Melanie warm up to her at her own pace. Melanie realizes this of course, but doesn't mind too much while they're in class. She just tries to steer clear of her outside of class to avoid getting locked into a conversation.

Layla moved to Walton a year ago, before that, she lived in Montreal. Due to living in a city with a great nightlife, she often went to raves and festivals with her friends. She was the type of girl who would stay sober for the events to be able to make sure everyone else was having a good time. Besides, with how much she loved EDM, she didn't need to be under the influence to have a good time. Her favourite DJs to see live were Illenium and Wooli, the way they blended dubstep and melodic dubstep always made their performances magical for her.

Despite living so far from her friends in Montreal, she still stays in contact with them because they've all been friends since pre-school. On her next break from school, she plans to go on a roadtrip and spend some time at a cottage in Mount Orford with them.

[In game description]
